summary: Legal Project Management is the application of project management principles to the delivery of legal services.
lede: Legal project management applies project management principles to legal service delivery, helping professionals make matters more predictable, control scope changes, track budgets, and support profitability. This course connects legal expertise with operational practices for managing matters under financial and regulatory pressure. You will learn to define matter scope with Work Breakdown Structures, build budgets, assign responsibilities through RACI matrices, and visualise progress with Kanban workflows. The training also introduces AI-assisted predictive analytics for legal spend forecasting, alongside practical approaches to risk mitigation, resource levelling, stakeholder reporting, and technology adoption.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for the operational and financial success of legal matters.
modules: Technology and AI in Legal Operations
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in a legal or professional services environment. Familiarity with basic legal matter workflows and financial reporting is recommended. No prior project management certification is required, though an intermediate understanding of legal billing practices is beneficial.
